title: Sculpted Lower Body
description: Sculpted lower body with pause lunges and single leg deadlifts, plus a core control block

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Fast marching in place
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place while swinging the arms

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Isometric squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bottom squat position without moving

exercises.name: Pause lunges
exercises.instructions: Lower and hold 3s at the bottom before rising

exercises.name: Single leg deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward, one leg lifts behind, keep your balance

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Like the hip thrust but flat on the floor, push the hips skyward

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, rise fully to touch the feet

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, quick flutter kicks

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over-under

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
